experiment dependency snapshot. No Git remotes accessed for this promotion.
libigl release archive provenance retained by that experiment:

Experimental acquisition also fetched missing headers from official libigl
Doxygen source pages. File hashes in manifest.json identify the exact copied
snapshot, rather than assuming every file came from the release archive.
Source copyright notices remain in individual files. MPL-2.0.txt accompanies
the snapshot. Eigen is compiled with EIGEN_MPL2_ONLY.
